description: Source code for wrt350nv2-builder, a tool to create firmware images for Linksys WRT350N v2 routers, including parsing parameter files, constructing binary images, zipping, and generating firmware files with embedded checksums.

classes.name: mtd_info
classes.description: Structure representing memory technology device (MTD) information such as name, offset, size, filename, filesize, and magic number.

methods.name: parse_par_file
methods.description: Parses the parameter file to populate MTD info structures and firmware version.

methods.name: create_bin_file
methods.description: Creates a binary firmware image file in memory, embedding files and special data, then writes it to disk.

methods.name: create_zip_file
methods.description: Creates a zip archive containing the binary firmware image.

methods.name: create_img_file
methods.description: Generates a firmware image file with embedded zip, header, and MD5 checksum.

methods.name: lprintf
methods.description: Logging function that outputs messages based on verbosity level.
